limitation_notes: Mechanical construction warning (docs/ECONOMETRIC_METHODOLOGY.md): provider gross fees are reported as a fee applied to the same provider's reported volume, so a fee-on-volume association largely restates the effective fee rate and must be displayed before any coefficient interpretation.
Both variables share one provider lineage (Dune); the association is not independent confirmation of anything.
The output is the named proxy association only; it is never protocol revenue (OQ-01) and H1/H4 stay unresolved (OQ-02 judging risk).
